Tiêu đề đề bài: Task 2.1: Impacts and Solutions of Cybercrime in the Digital Era
Nội dung chi tiết:
Read the following statement:

"As digital connectivity expands, cybercrime—such as online identity theft, financial fraud, and cyber harassment—has emerged as a severe threat to individuals and businesses worldwide."

Write an essay to an educated reader examining the primary impacts of cybercrime and proposing effective solutions that governments and internet users can take to combat it. Support your arguments with specific reasons and illustrative examples.
title: Task 2.1: Impacts and Solutions of Cybercrime in the Digital Era
content:
Read the following statement:

"As digital connectivity expands, cybercrime—such as online identity theft, financial fraud, and cyber harassment—has emerged as a severe threat to individuals and businesses worldwide."

Write an essay to an educated reader examining the primary impacts of cybercrime and proposing effective solutions that governments and internet users can take to combat it. Support your arguments with specific reasons and illustrative examples.

body1.example: For instance, my brother was tricked by a fake bank message while checking his phone during a busy workday. Therefore, he decided to click the link and entered his card number to verify his account. As a result, he finally lost five million dong and spent days reporting the scam. If he had not clicked that strange link, he would not have been stressed and out of pocket.
body1.focus: Primary impacts of cybercrime on individuals and businesses
body1.frame: Mở: First and foremost, cybercrime leads to several serious negative effects | Ruột ĐOẠN 1 | Chốt: Clearly, these are the key impacts of cybercrime.
body1.point: A very important point to consider is that cybercrime causes serious financial loss and identity theft for everyday users. This means that sharing private details online or clicking strange links allows cyber criminals to steal bank accounts and personal identities easily. Another point I would like to make is that online attacks damage trust and hurt business operations. This is because of the fact that companies lose customer data, spend a lot of money fixing systems, and victims feel stressed and unsafe online.

body2.example: For example, internet users can turn on two-step verification and check sender addresses carefully, while local banks and tech companies send scam alerts and run free digital safety talks for citizens.
body2.focus: Practical solutions for internet users, platforms, and governments
body2.frame: Mở: In order to resolve such problems, both individuals and organizations should take practical measures | Ruột Solutions (Cá nhân + Tổ chức + Education)
body2.point: One primary solution would be that individuals should stay on the safe side by using strong passwords, avoiding strange links, and protecting their private details online. In addition, tech companies and local authorities need to improve data security, set clear safety rules, and investigate online fraud quickly. Above all, education plays a key role in tackling this issue, because people need to be aware of its impacts so that they can act responsibly.

hint.conclusion: In conclusion, cybercrime in the digital era is closely linked to serious financial loss and stolen personal identities and requires practical steps such as safer online habits, stronger platform security, and public education. Therefore, both citizens and local authorities need to take steady, practical actions to reduce this problem in the long run.

intro.ld1: serious financial loss and stolen personal identities
intro.ld2: safer online habits, stronger data security, and public education

Tiêu đề đề bài: Task 1.2: Recommending Sightseeing, Transport, and Cultural Venues to Pen Pal Jack
Nội dung chi tiết:
You have received an email from your pen pal, Jack, who is traveling to your hometown with a group of friends next month. Read part of his email below:

"My friends and I are finalizing our travel plan to your city! Since you know the area well, could you recommend some must-see sights for young travelers? Would it be better for us to use public transport or rent a private vehicle, and is there an engaging history museum or cultural site where we can learn about local history?"

Write an informal email responding to Jack.
title: Task 1.2: Recommending Sightseeing, Transport, and Cultural Venues to Pen Pal Jack
content:
You have received an email from your pen pal, Jack, who is traveling to your hometown with a group of friends next month. Read part of his email below:

"My friends and I are finalizing our travel plan to your city! Since you know the area well, could you recommend some must-see sights for young travelers? Would it be better for us to use public transport or rent a private vehicle, and is there an engaging history museum or cultural site where we can learn about local history?"

Write an informal email responding to Jack.

body.answer: For young travelers like your group, you should visit our old quarter, the riverside art street, and the lively local night market.
body.example: For example, you can walk along the riverside in the late afternoon, take group photos by the old bridge, and enjoy street food together.
body.frame: I am genuinely thrilled to hear that you are planning to visit my hometown! There are two suggestions that I would like to make.
body.reason: When it comes to food and sightseeing, these places let you try authentic local snacks and broaden your mind about modern youth life in my hometown.

body.answer: Since you are traveling in a group, I think it is better to book ride-hailing cars or rent a small van with a driver rather than relying only on public buses.
body.example: For instance, splitting a 7-seat car among four or five friends costs almost the same as bus tickets and takes you directly to distant beaches or hills.
body.frame: From my point of view, I think that ______. / I believe you should ______.
body.reason: Sharing a vehicle is fast and convenient for busy travelers, fits comfortably within your group budget, and helps you stay on the safe side on unfamiliar roads.
body.requirement: Advise whether to use public transport or rent a private vehicle

body.answer: To learn about local history, I recommend visiting the Provincial History Museum and the ancient temple next to it.
body.example: Why don't you join the free 9:00 AM English guided tour at the museum? It explains traditional crafts and old stories in a fun way.
body.frame: I would like to give you information on ______. / Why don't you [V-bare] ______?
body.reason: These sites provide knowledge and experience in local heritage and help you gain a deeper understanding of people, culture, and tradition here.
body.requirement: Recommend an engaging history museum or cultural site to learn about local history

Tiêu đề đề bài: Task 2.2: Arranged Marriages versus Love Marriages
Nội dung chi tiết:
Read the following statement:

"In some traditional cultures, arranged marriages organized by parents and family elders are still prevalent, while in modern societies, most people insist on choosing their own life partner based on romantic love."

Write an essay to an educated reader discussing both arranged marriages and love marriages, and give your own perspective on which approach fosters long-term marital stability and happiness. Support your arguments with specific reasons and illustrative examples.
title: Task 2.2: Arranged Marriages versus Love Marriages
content:
Read the following statement:

"In some traditional cultures, arranged marriages organized by parents and family elders are still prevalent, while in modern societies, most people insist on choosing their own life partner based on romantic love."

Write an essay to an educated reader discussing both arranged marriages and love marriages, and give your own perspective on which approach fosters long-term marital stability and happiness. Support your arguments with specific reasons and illustrative examples.

body1.example: For instance, my brother was very busy with his job and had little time to meet new people in his late twenties. Therefore, he decided to meet a kind woman introduced by our parents and relatives. As a result, he finally received warm support from both families and felt less lonely. If he had not listened to our parents' advice, he would not have been introduced to someone with similar family values.
body1.focus: View 1: Why some support arranged marriages
body1.frame: Mở: First and foremost, people should recognize why some support arranged marriages | Ruột ĐOẠN 1 | Chốt: Clearly, this perspective has reasonable points.
body1.point: A very important point to consider is that parents have rich life experience and want a safe, stable match for their children. This means that elders carefully look at family background, habits, and financial stability to help young couples stay on the safe side. Another point I would like to make is that arranged marriages often receive strong support from both families. This is because of the fact that relatives agree with the match from the start and are ready to help the new couple with housing or childcare.

body2.example: For example, I was able to see how my older sister dated her husband for three years before getting married. For this reason, I got to learn that spending time together beforehand helps couples handle daily disagreements calmly. If I had not watched their happy marriage closely, I would not have been able to know that genuine love and mutual understanding matter so much for a lasting home.
body2.focus: View 2 (Preferred): Why love marriages lead to lasting happiness
body2.frame: Mở: On the other hand, there are stronger arguments in support of love marriages | Ruột ĐOẠN 2 | Chốt: It is clear that love marriages are a more practical choice.
body2.point: In fact, marrying someone out of genuine love and mutual understanding builds a happier home than following an arranged marriage forced by parents. This happens because when couples choose each other freely and get to know each other through face-to-face interaction, it easily leads to deeper trust and fewer serious conflicts. In addition, partners who share common goals and true respect can support each other smoothly through difficult times.

hint.conclusion: In conclusion, although both views have reasonable points, I prefer love marriages because it allows people to build mutual understanding before marriage and enjoy lasting emotional happiness. Therefore, both individuals and families should work together to make the most of marriage decisions responsibly.

intro.ld2: stronger emotional happiness and lasting trust

Nội dung chi tiết:
Read the following statement:

"With the ubiquity of social networks, millions of internet users share their daily lives, personal achievements, and family moments online. Many people argue that sharing our lives online has brought overwhelmingly positive impacts by fostering connection and inspiration."

Write an essay to an educated reader discussing to what extent you agree or disagree with the statement that sharing our lives online has many positive impacts. Support your arguments with specific reasons and illustrative examples.
group: Đề thi thực tế DTU (Ca sáng bổ sung)
title: Task 2.3: Discussing the Positive and Negative Impacts of Sharing Our Lives Online
content:
Read the following statement:

"With the ubiquity of social networks, millions of internet users share their daily lives, personal achievements, and family moments online. Many people argue that sharing our lives online has brought overwhelmingly positive impacts by fostering connection and inspiration."

Write an essay to an educated reader discussing to what extent you agree or disagree with the statement that sharing our lives online has many positive impacts. Support your arguments with specific reasons and illustrative examples.

body1.example: For instance, my brother was feeling lonely after moving to another city for his first full-time job. Therefore, he decided to share short weekend photos and updates on his family group online. As a result, he finally felt closer to our parents and old friends despite living far away. If he had not shared his daily moments online, he would not have been so cheerful in his new city.
body1.focus: Positive impact 1: Staying closely connected with loved ones and like-minded people
body1.frame: Mở: First and foremost, people should recognize that sharing daily moments online strengthens social connections | Ruột ĐOẠN 1 | Chốt: Clearly, staying connected online brings undeniable value in modern life.
body1.point: A very important point to consider is that sharing our daily lives online is fast and convenient for busy people in modern-day society. This means that friends and relatives living in different cities or countries can easily follow each other's updates and stay close. Another point I would like to make is that posting personal hobbies helps people meet like-minded people and enrich their social life. This is because of the fact that shared photos and stories create warm conversations and a strong sense of belonging.

body2.example: For example, I was nervous about preparing for my English exam while working part-time last semester. For this reason, I got to follow a student blogger who shared her daily study routine and honest tips online. If I had not read her encouraging posts, I would not have been able to know that sharing real-life experiences online can motivate others so strongly.
body2.focus: Positive impact 2: Inspiring others and sharing helpful life experiences
body2.frame: Mở: Secondly, there are further arguments in support of the idea that sharing personal achievements online inspires and helps others | Ruột ĐOẠN 2 | Chốt: It is clear that inspiring others online plays an important role.
body2.point: In fact, sharing personal achievements and everyday lessons online can motivate many people to build better habits. This happens because when users post honest stories about learning a skill, cooking healthy food, or exercising daily, it easily leads to positive encouragement and practical ideas for readers. In addition, seeing real progress from ordinary people helps broaden our mind and boosts our confidence when facing challenges.

hint.conclusion: In conclusion, I strongly agree that sharing our lives online has many positive impacts, mainly because it helps people stay closely connected with loved ones and supports positive inspiration among users. Therefore, both individuals and tech companies should work together to make the most of sharing online responsibly.

intro.ld1: it helps people stay closely connected with faraway friends and family
